title: docs(skills): an owner, assignee or 负责人 in a request is the injected owner_id

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XACQi5GZRKaJH4A4nUXpUQP)_

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-data 技能的「Record owner」规则写明:需求里的负责人、处理人、assignee、owner 就是平台注入的 `owner_id`,不另建字段;只有需求明确区分「负责人」和另一位处理者时才加一个 `user` 字段,且标签不得与对象上任何可见字段重名(点名注入列 `owner_id` Owner/负责人、`created_by` 创建人、`updated_by` 更新人、`created_at`、`updated_at`),并说明它不授予访问权。快速模板里的工单示例去掉了 `assigned_to` 字段,新增 eval 19(工单应用 + 负责人)。
- 为什么改:staging 上 AI 搭建的工单应用多建了一个标签也叫「负责人」的 `assignee` 字段,表格两列「负责人」、看板重复显示,而只有 `owner_id` 决定记录可见性。技能里的快速模板正好教了一个 `assigned_to` 用户字段。
- 风险与回滚:只改对外发布的技能文字和一条 eval,无代码、无契约改动;`@objectstack/skills` patch。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 的 Record owner 行;`references/examples-objects.md` 快速模板的 `// assignee` 行;`evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 的 id 19。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-data/SKILL.md`,预期 `6657 tokens (ceiling 6665; headroom 8)`。
- 需要你做的:审阅并合并(`skills/**` 属 Tier H,需你亲手合并或授权批准)。

## What changes

All in `skills/objectstack-data/` (one owner file for the rule, two cross-references, one eval):

- **`SKILL.md`, Relationship Patterns → Record owner row (the rule).** The row already said "never a hand-added owner / person in charge lookup". It now says the same `owner_id` answers a request's assignee, 负责人 or 处理人, and that a handler the request names apart from the owner is a `user` field that grants no access, with a label no other visible field carries, the injected columns included: `owner_id` (Owner, 负责人), `created_by` (创建人), `updated_by` (更新人), `created_at` (创建时间), `updated_at` (更新时间). The Field Type Selection bullet drops `assignee` from its `user`-field examples so the two places no longer disagree.
- **`references/examples-objects.md`, Quick-Start Template (cross-reference 1).** The `support_case` template declared `assigned_to: { type: 'user' }` beside the injected `owner_id`: the exact shape the staging build produced. It is replaced by the comment `// assignee: the injected owner_id`.
- **`rules/field-types.md`, `user` row (cross-reference 2).** The example list reads `(reviewer, watchers)` instead of `(assignee, watchers)`; same byte count.
- **`evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, eval 19** (and one README phrase). The prompt asks, in Chinese, for a ticket app whose 负责人 can be reassigned. It expects `owner_id` reused and must not contain `assignee:`, `assigned_to:` or `label: '负责人'`.

The label set is measured, not guessed: `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts` defines the injected columns (`owner_id` label `Owner`, not hidden; `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by` not hidden; `organization_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue` hidden), and `SYSTEM_FIELD_LABELS` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` serves their zh-CN labels (`owner_id` → 负责人, `created_by` → 创建人, `updated_by` → 更新人, `created_at` → 创建时间, `updated_at` → 更新时间).

## Acceptance notes

- **No build check exists today.** `git grep` over `packages/lint/src`, `packages/spec/src`, `packages/objectql/src` and `packages/cli/src` for a duplicate- or colliding-label rule has no hit. The check is split to #33545 and is not touched here.
- **The objectstack-ui skill still teaches `assigned_to` as the owner column.** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` has `{ field: 'assigned_to', label: 'Owner' }` and a "mine" filter on `assigned_to` (lines 53, 60, 101, 321), `rules/actions.md:44` uses it as a param, and `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 1 answers a prompt's "owner" column with `assigned_to`. That is outside this order's surface (two cross-references); reported to the seat as a follow-up.
- **Token payment, no ceiling raised.** `SKILL.md` is 6657 tokens against its 6665 ceiling (6606 on the original base `e3f0cfd4`; 6665 on today's `main`, after #33458's `aiReadable` row spent the headroom round 1 had used). The new text costs about 82 tokens, all paid by deleting restatement in the same file: the `(maintainer ruling 2026-08-13)` aside; the `(ADR-0113)`, `(ADR-0061)`, `ADR-0120` and `(ADR-0146 D10)` asides; the line "Toggle system behaviours per object:" that restates its heading; the `ObjectExtensionSchema` and `PermissionSetSchema.objects.*` schema pointers (`references/_index.md` already points at `object.zod.ts` and `permission.zod.ts`); the internal constant name `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`; "See rules/validation.md for all types and examples." (the Quick Reference list links it); and a shorter new sentence. No eval expects any of the deleted text.
- **Round 2 merge (`4fccfc87`, `origin/main` `7f0e38a2`).** #33586 added its own eval 18 to `objects-fields-relationships.json`; main's file is kept whole and this PR's eval follows unchanged as id 19. #33589's `field-types.md` lines are intact; this PR's diff there is still only the `user` row's example word.

## Verification

Changed: 6 files, +40 / -19 (head `a2d3008d`). `dispatch-gates --tier`: `Model tier — MANDATORY: claude-fable-5-2` (`skills/**`, no one-line exit). `check-governed-merges --branch`: GOVERNED, Tier H (5 of 6 paths on the register; the changeset is not), 59 changed lines, under 3000. Changeset: `.changeset/33506-skills-owner-id-for-assignee.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (`skills/**` ships in `dist/skills`).
